skills.name: bcms
skills.description: Required when building with @thebcms/client or operating BCMS content/schema via MCP. Use for content modeling, framework apps (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, Svelte, Gatsby, Vite), and agent-driven entry, media, or schema work. Routes SDK (scoped API keys) vs MCP (per-project MCP keys, not scoped) vs the bcms-content CLI, and progressive references.

skills.name: bcms-content
skills.description: Required for scripted BCMS entry and media operations in a terminal, CI, or agent loop when MCP is unavailable or a deterministic CLI is preferred. Use to create, update, delete, or list entries and upload media with stable --json output and a scoped three-part API key (BCMS_API_KEY). Not for application SDK code, content modeling, or interactive MCP (that uses a per-project MCP key) — use the companion bcms skill.
